description: Get a combined snapshot of a Bilibili user: profile, videos, dynamics, and articles.

article_limit.description: Maximum number of articles to include (default 10).

dynamic_limit.description: Maximum number of dynamics to include (default 10).

user_id_or_username.description: Bilibili user ID (mid) or exact username.

video_limit.description: Maximum number of videos to include (default 10).

name: get_user_snapshot
